mechanism: Amantadine may increase dronedarone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and reduces renal clearance of dronedarone metabolites, while both drugs carry cardiac arrhythmia risks and amantadine has anticholinergic properties that may worsen cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor cardiac function closely with ECG and electrolytes; consider dose adjustment of dronedarone or alternative antiarrhythmic if amantadine is necessary; assess for QT prolongation and bradycardia.
